QuestInfo.2: I took care of the challenge Mai gave me. That was easy...

0.0: Hey, do you want to try this quest I have for you?

yes.0: Okay, then! Collect these items for me: #b10 Mushroom Spores, 10 Snail Shells, and 10 Red Snail Shells#k. Good luck!
yes.1: A lot of people have received my challenge, only to give up and leave the island all together. To become a great traveler requires more than just pure strength; it also requires ample amounts of patience and intensity. Now, good luck and I'll see you here!

no.0: Remember, if you ever decide to leave this island, there's no turning back. You cannot come back here, plain and simple. Can you come see me first before heading over to Victoria Island?

1.0: Ahh! It's you. Did you gather up the items I asked you to get?

yes.0: Good work there. You got me all the items I asked you to get. It must have been difficult for you to gather up those items. I'm very impressed, and I can tell you're destined to become a wonderful traveler even after leaving Maple Island. Here, take this; Hope you put this to good use!

item.0: Hey, I don't think you have the right number of items I was looking for. You need to collect #b10 Mushroom Spores, 10 Snail Shells, and 10 Red Snail Shells#k for me!
